caseStudies.title: Enterprise RAG Rollout
caseStudies.problem: Support teams drowning in documentation; generic chatbots failed compliance review.
caseStudies.approach: Hybrid retrieval, PHI-aware guardrails, human-in-the-loop escalation.

caseStudies.outcome: 28% reduction in mean time to resolution for L2 incidents.
